chapters.title: Walk in truth and refuse support for deception

parts.text: The elder writes to the elect lady and her children in truth and love, wishing grace, mercy, and peace from the Father and his Son. He rejoices that some of her children walk in truth. His appeal is the commandment heard from the beginning: love one another, with love expressed in obedience to God’s commandments.

He warns against deceivers who deny Jesus Christ come in the flesh. The readers must guard their reward and remain in Christ’s doctrine. Receiving or encouraging a teacher who does not bring it makes them participants in his evil work. The elder hopes to speak face to face for fuller joy and sends greetings from her sister’s children.
